parsed.post: Huge jump! DEPTH=6 and MATRIX_LR=0.08 gave me 1.006426, beating my previous best of 1.034721. It seems my previous attempt to lower LR to 0.05 (from my round 6 plan) was actually a regression or the higher LR was better for this 5-min budget. Next: I'll try adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 and WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to stabilize this high-LR capacity run.
parsed.description: Adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 and WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to the successful DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.08 configuration to see if regularization and warmup allow for even better convergence.
